title: Measure delivery, coordination, and memory separately
question: Which outcome supports the claim that the team or lesson helped?
summary: Classroom comparisons illustrate tradeoffs. They do not establish that swarms or memory generally improve performance.

steps.title: Match starting conditions
steps.body: Use the same work order, data, model, cases, and total request allowance. Count planning, integration, and retries.

steps.title: Read the solo/team outcome
steps.body: In the recorded build, solo passed 10/10 scenarios and the team passed 8/10. One UTC defect caused two failing checks.

steps.title: Read the memory outcome
steps.body: The recorded follow-up builds each passed 12/18 scenarios. The selected lesson did not improve that score.

steps.title: Keep incomplete releases blocked
steps.body: A release decision requires available passing outcomes. Missing results are not passes.
steps.code:
